picture-pairs.name: Veiwatini ni iyaloyalo
picture-pairs.seoTitle: Pairing Game for Adults: Picture Pairs
picture-pairs.h1: Veiwatini ni iyaloyalo: e dua na qito ni veiganiti malumu
picture-pairs.description: A free, gentle matching game for adults and older adults, including people living with dementia. Pictures can stay showing. No timer or score.
picture-pairs.short: Vaqara na iyaloyalo e rua e tautauvata. Na iyaloyalo e rawa ni vakaraitaki tikoga.
picture-pairs.intro: Tabaka e dua na iyaloyalo, qai tabaka na kena e veiganiti kei na kena. Na iyaloyalo e tiko vakaraitaka ena kena ivakarau, sa sega kina ni dua na ka e dodonu me nanumi. Ni rau lako vata e rua na iyaloyalo erau rawata e dua na iyalayala koula kei na dua na ivakatakilakila ni jeke.
howTo: Digitaka na levu ni tile mo vakayagataka. Va na tile e dua na vanua vakacegu me tekivu kina.
Tabaka na iyaloyalo cava ga. E rawata e dua na iyalayala koula.
Tabaka na iyaloyalo e tautauvata na kena irairai. Erau tiko vata na veiwatini kei na dua na ivakatakilakila ni jeke.
Ke duidui na iyaloyalo e rua, ena sega ni yaco e dua na ka ca. Tap tale ena gauna cava ga o sa vakarau kina.
Vukica na "iyaloyalo vuni" kevaka walega drau marautaka ruarua na kalasi ni mata-sobu na kena itukutuku.
tips: Vakayacana vata na iyaloyalo ena domo levu ka veitalanoataka me baleti ira: "E dua na bilo ti damudamu. O dau taura na sucu ena nomu ti?"
Laiva na tamata o qarava me cakava na tapping, kevaka mada ga e taura e dua na gauna. Dusia ka sega ni tabaka vei ira.
Tiko vata kei na va na taile me baleta na balavu ni gauna e vakila vinaka kina. E levu cake na tile e dua na digidigi, sega vakadua ni dua na ivakatagedegede me yacovi.
Vakaotia ni se marautaki tiko. E dua na qito e dua na itaviqaravi taucoko.

faq.q: E tiko beka e dua na gauna se dua na sikoa?
faq.a: Sega.E sega ni dua na kaloko, sikoa, toso ni counter se lusi. E rawa ni o cegu ena dua na gauna, kei na cegu ena veimama ni sala e dua na sala vinaka sara me vakaoti kina.

faq.q: Na cava era tu kina na iyaloyalo?
faq.a: Na kena maroroi na iyaloyalo me laurai e vukica na qito ki na rai kei na veiganiti ka sega ni nanumi. E levu era kunea ni vakacegu oqo. E rawa ni o veisau ki na iyaloyalo vuni ena dua ga na tap kevaka o vinakata.

faq.q: E sega ni saumi, ka dodonu beka meu sainitaka?
faq.a: Io, e sega ni saumi, ka sega ni dua na akaude, saini-cake se lavetaki. E cakacaka ena barausa ni itukutuku ena dua na talevoni, tebeleti se kompiuta.

faq.q: E rawa beka ni da vakayagataka na noda dui itaba vakavuvale?
faq.a: Io. Tovolea na veiwatini ni itaba, ka rawa kina vei iko mo digitaka na itaba mai na nomu misini. Na itaba e tiko ena nomu barausa ka sega ni vakau cake.

find-the-same.description: One picture at the top, two to four below. Tap the one that is the same. A calm, free picture game for adults, older adults and families, with no timer.

Raica vata na iyaloyalo e cake.

shadow-match.name: Veisotari ni yaloyalo
shadow-match.seoTitle: Shadow Matching Game: Free Online for Adults
shadow-match.h1: Veisotari ni yaloyalo: e dua na qito ni iyaloyalo malumu
shadow-match.description: A dark shadow at the top, two to four pictures below. Tap the picture that makes the shadow. A free, calm shadow matching game with no timer.
shadow-match.short: Raica na yaloyalo ka tabaka na iyaloyalo e cakava.
shadow-match.intro: Na veiganiti ni yaloyalo e dua na itaviqaravi kilai levu mai na pepa ni cakacaka tabaki, eke kei na iyaloyalo lelevu ka sega ni dua na ka me tabaki. E dua na yaloyalo malumu e dabe toka ena dela ni sikirini ka rua, tolu se va na iyaloyalo e waraka tiko e ra. Tabaka na kena e cakava na yaloyalo. Na ibulibuli me vaka e dua na basikeli, e dua na umauma se dua na bilo ti e rawarawa me vosataki talega.
howTo: Digitaka e rua, tolu se va na iyaloyalo mo digitaka mai kina. E rua na ka rawarawa duadua.
Raica vata na yaloyalo. Na ibulibuli cava e tiko kina? E balavu se vakababa?
Tabaka na iyaloyalo e cakava na yaloyalo. E basika na yacana ena ruku ni yaloyalo.

Tap "Yaloyalo ka tarava" ni o sa vakarau tu me baleta e dua tale.
tips: Vakaraitaka na ituvatuva ni yaloyalo ena dua na iqaqalo ka vosa me baleta na kena irairai.
Kevaka e vakila dredre na yaloyalo nikua, veisau ki na Vaqara na kena vata ga, na vanua e tautauvata kina na iyaloyalo.
Veivosakitaka na iyaloyalo ena gauna ga e kune kina: "E tiko vei keitou e dua na umauma vakaoqo."

faq.q: Can people living with dementia enjoy shadow matching?
faq.a: Many adults enjoy it, including some people living with dementia, often in the earlier stages. Shapes are easier to recognize than words. It is for enjoyment and conversation, not a test, and it does not treat or slow dementia. If it causes frustration, try Find the same or simply look at pictures together.

four-together.name: Four together
four-together.seoTitle: Picture Grouping Game for Adults: Four Together
four-together.h1: Four Together: a Calm Picture Grouping Game
four-together.description: Some of the pictures share a theme, such as fruit or weather. Tap the ones that go together. A free, calm grouping game with no timer and no score.
four-together.short: Find the pictures that go together, like fruit or weather.
four-together.intro: A small set of pictures, and some of them belong together: four kinds of fruit, perhaps, or four ways to travel. Tap the ones that share a theme. If a picture goes with something else, the game simply names it and waits. After a quiet pause a hint names the theme, and "Show the group" reveals the answer at any time.
howTo: Choose four, six or eight pictures. Four is the simplest, with three that go together.
Look at the pictures together and talk about what they have in common.
Tap each picture that belongs in the group. It gets a gold border and a check mark.
If a picture goes with something else, the game names it and waits. Take your time.
Tap "Show the group" whenever you like, then "Another set" for new pictures.
tips: Say what you notice out loud: "These two are both things to eat."
There is no rush. A hint naming the theme appears after a pause, and you can ignore it.
Talk about the group once it is found: a favorite fruit, a train journey, the weather today.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: What happens if a picture from outside the group is tapped?
faq.a: Nothing unpleasant. There is no buzzer, red cross or shaking. The game names the picture, says it goes with something else, and waits for the next tap.

faq.q: What are the groups?
faq.a: Everyday themes that need no special knowledge: fruit, animals, flowers, weather, ways to travel, things for a hot drink and things baked in an oven. Each picture belongs to just one group.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

odd-one-out.name: Odd one out
odd-one-out.seoTitle: Odd One Out Picture Game for Adults
odd-one-out.h1: Odd One Out: a Relaxed Picture Game
odd-one-out.description: Three or four pictures, and all but one share a theme, such as fruit or weather. Tap the one that does not belong. Free, calm, no timer and no score.
odd-one-out.short: Spot the picture that does not belong with the others.
odd-one-out.intro: Three or four pictures, and all but one go together: fruit, perhaps, or ways to travel. Tap the picture that does not belong. If a picture does go with the others, the game simply says so and waits. After a quiet pause a hint names what the others share, and "Show me" points out the odd one at any time.
howTo: Choose three or four pictures. Three is the simplest.
Look at the pictures together and talk about what most of them have in common.
Tap the picture that does not belong. It gets a gold border and a check mark.
If a picture goes with the others, the game says so and waits. Take your time.
Tap "Show me" whenever you like, then "Another set" for new pictures.
tips: Talk it through out loud: "The apple and the pear are both fruit. What about the bus?"
There is no rush. A hint naming the theme appears after a pause, and you can ignore it.
Any picture is a good start for a chat: a favorite fruit, a bus ride, a rainy day.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: What happens if a picture that belongs is tapped?
faq.a: Nothing unpleasant. There is no buzzer, red cross or shaking. The game names the picture, says it goes with the others, and waits for the next tap.

faq.q: How is the odd picture chosen?
faq.a: The pictures come from everyday themes that need no special knowledge: fruit, animals, flowers, weather, ways to travel, things for a hot drink and things baked in an oven. Each picture belongs to just one theme, and the odd one always comes from a different theme.

color-match.name: Vakatautauri ena kulukulu
color-match.seoTitle: Vakatautauri ena kulukulu: Na Veikeli Malumalumu ena Dua na Vakatutu
color-match.h1: Vakatautauri ena kulukulu: Vakasaqarai na Vakatutu ena Dua na Kulukulu
color-match.description: Dua na kulukulu levu vakatokai ena yacana, kei na vakatutu e vica se ono. Tokai vakatutu kecega era ena kulukulu oqo. Sega ni kena tiaki, sega ni kena maka, ia dua na kulukulu tale ga e vakatokai. E vakaveivakalougaci me veiceguci kei me vakadidike.
color-match.short: Vakasaqarai na vakatutu kecega era ena kulukulu e cakava.
color-match.players: 1 se 2 na tamata, se dua na tamata matua kei dua na gone
color-match.intro: E vakaraitaki dua na kulukulu levu, ena veiyacana ena yacana, ia ena yaga e vakatokai. Ena icaka e vica se ono na vakatutu. Tokai vakatutu kecega era ena kulukulu oqo: me vaka na mere damudamu kei na kapu damudamu. Ke dua na vakatutu e kulukulu tale, veikeli e vakaraitaki ena vosa ("Na pea e loaloa.") ia e tu kina. "Vakaraitaki vei ira" e vakaraitaka na vakatutu e vakatautauri, ia "Kulukulu tale" e cabe ki na dua tale.
howTo: Digitaka vakatutu e va se e ono. E va e vakalougata duadua.
Raica na kulukulu kei me vosa vakavevuki na yacana ena vosa.
Tokai vakatutu kecega era ena kulukulu oqo. Dua-dua era na gunuva na ulunivanua dredre kei na mataqali makasi.
Ke dua na vakatutu e kulukulu tale, veikeli e vakaraitaka na kulukulu ena vakatutu oya ia e tu kina. Vakaqaqi na gauna.
Tokai "Vakaraitaki vei ira" ke vinaka, ia "Kulukulu tale" me dua na kulukulu vou.
tips: Vosa vakaukauwai na kulukulu, ia raica na koro: na cava tale ga e kulukulu oya?
Vosa ena nomu vosa kevaka e vinaka. "Tomato" se "lagi" e tautauvata ga kei "damudamu" se "vulavula".
Vakaraitaki e rawa ni vakalougata ga me vaka na tokai. Tu vata ka raica vata na sikirini.

faq.q: E tiko kina na taimaa se maka?
faq.a: Sega. Sega ni taimaa, maka, kaunita ni cakacaka se cudru. E rawa ni nomu tu ena gauna kecega, ia na tu ena rua ni cakacaka e dua na ituvatuva vinaka me oti kina.

faq.q: Na cava e yaco ke tokai dua na vakatutu e kulukulu tale?
faq.a: Sega ni dua na cakacaka ca. Sega ni dua na ulu, sega ni dua na cross damudamu, se vakalialia. Na veikeli e vakaraitaka na vakatutu kei na kulukulu, me vaka na "Na pea e loaloa.", ia e tu kina me cabe ki na tokai tale.

faq.q: E ra kulukulu ga na veitaratara?
faq.a: Sega. E vakaraitaki na kulukulu me dua na veiyacana levu, ia e vakatokai era vosa, ia dua-dua na vakatutu e vakatokai ke tokai. Ke dua e kila tiko na kulukulu, e rawa ni vakatautauri ga ena nona wiliwili na yacana.

faq.q: E dredre tiko ga na vakatutu oya?
faq.a: Era digitaka ena lima, ia era vakaraitaki ga na vakatutu e kulukulu tiko na ka ca. Na vakatutu e ulunivanua tiko e vica na kulukulu, me vaka na kaite se na vuka, era sa qaqaraki.

faq.q: E rawa ni vakadidike ena pepa?
faq.a: Io. Dua na pepa e tolu na laini. Dua-dua na laini e vakatokai dua na kulukulu ia e vakaraitaka vakatutu e va me vakaraitaka se me vakavolekati.

color-by-number.name: Kala ena nomba
color-by-number.seoTitle: Kala ena Nomba: Dua na Veicaka Malumalu ena Ibalebale Levu
color-by-number.h1: Kala ena Nomba: Vakavuna na Yasa Dria, Kala e Yaga Vei Iko
color-by-number.description: Ibalebale ni yasa dria levu e nomba, kei na lewe e va na kala ena yacana kei na veiqaqa. Digitaki na kala, qai tapa na yasa dria me vakavuna. E sega ni liga se maraqa, e tu kina na kala e yaga, kei na butona e vakavuna na yasa dria ena nomba. E sega ni dokai ena caka kei na peni.
color-by-number.short: Digitaki na kala, qai tapa na yasa dria e nomba me vakavuna.
color-by-number.players: 1 se 2 na tamata, vata ena yasa dua
color-by-number.intro: Ibalebale vuaka lalai e yasa dria levu, kai dua na nomba ena yasa dua, kei na lewe i vuka ena ibalebale e va na kala, dua na nomba kei na yacana ni vosa ena kala dua. Digitaki na kala mai ena lewe, qai tapa na yasa dria me vakavuna ena kala. E 4 by 4 ena ibalebale ena matavuvale, kei na 6 by 6 se 8 by 8 ke vinakata na yasa dria levu. Ke vakavuna kece na yasa dria ena kala e tautauvata ki na nomba, na ibalebale oqo e vakatakarakara ena peji. Na yasa dria e vakavuna ena kala e sega ni tautauvata, e vakatakarakara vakadua nei iko, ka sega ni vakaraitaki na game. "Vakavuna ena nomba" e vakavuna na yasa dria kece e sega ni vakavuna.

Tapa dua na kala ena lewe, qai tapa na yasa dria era vinakata me vakavuna ena kala oya.
Digitaki na kala e tiko ena nomba, se kala e yaga vei iko. Dou rawa vakalevu.
Tapa "Vakavuna ena nomba" me vakavuna na yasa dria e sega ni vakavuna, "Dau sa" me yaga ena ibalebale, se "Vakatakarakara e yaga" me dua na vakatakarakara vou.
tips: Tu vata ena yasa dua ka vakavuvuli: dua na tamata e digitaki na kala, na ikarua e tapa na yasa dria.
Vosa vata nodra kala: "Au via kila na ulaula." E sega ni dodonu me vakaraitaki na yacana ni vakatakarakara e vakavuna.
Ena screen e lalai, ibalebale 8 by 8 e lewe ena ibalebale ni kabi. Na yasa dria era tiko ena levu e vinaka.
Na vakatakarakara ena pepa e rawa talega ena peni ena dela ni katuba me vakavuna.

faq.q: E tiko kina na wati se na nomba?
faq.a: Sega. E sega na kolako, nomba, kena vuna ni caka, se sa qaroti. E rawa ni tu ena gauna eda vinakata, kei na tu ena vakaoti e dua na ituvatuva vinaka.

faq.q: Se vica ke digitaki na kala e sega ni tautauvata ki na nomba?
faq.a: E sega ni yaco dina, kei na kena ibalebale. Kala e yaga e rawa ni tu ena yasa dria yaga, kei na game e sega ni vosa vakadua. Ke sa tautauvata na kala kei na nomba ena yasa dria kece, game e vakaraitaka vakalevu ena vosa vinaka, ka na vakatakarakara ni kala iko era dau vinaka talega.

faq.q: E rawa beka ni kila na kala ena tamata e sega ni kila na kala?
faq.a: E digitaki me vakatautauvata. Kala e yaga e tiko vata kei na nomba, yacana ni vosa kei na veivakatakarakara lalai, ka sega ni kala duadua e vakaraitaki ena vakasamataka. Na kala e va e vakatautauvata ena ulumatai kei na ulumuri, kei na veivakatautauvata ena yasa. Ke dua na kala e vakatautauvata vei iko, vakaraitaka mai.

faq.q: Na yasa dria e levu beka vei ira e vakasakiti vei ira kei na screen lalai?
faq.a: Yasa dria kece e yaco ena 48 pixel ena vuaka, kei na 56 ena ibalebale 4 by 4. Kevaka e levu tiko na ibalebale ena screen, e laki kashiva ena ibalebale kina, sega ni vakalailaitaka na yasa dria.

faq.q: E dua beka na vakatakarakara ena pepa?
faq.a: Io. Peji e dua e tiko kina na ibalebale e nomba kei na lewe ni kala e va kei na yacana. Kala e yasa dria kece ena peni e dua ena kala ena nomba, se kala e yaga vei iko.

faq.q: E sega ni dokai beka, se e dodonu me vakayaloqaraka?
faq.a: Io, e sega ni dokai, ka sega talega na akaunti, na vakayaloqaraki se na download. E rawa ni caka ena vakatakarakara ni initaneti ena foni, tebolete se komputa.

pattern-maker.name: Kawa ni vakatakarakara
pattern-maker.seoTitle: Kawa ni Vakatakarakara: Caka e Dua na Vuaka ka Vakaraitaka na Vakatakarakara
pattern-maker.h1: Kawa ni Vakatakarakara: Caka e Dua na Vuaka, Raica ni Vakatakarakara
pattern-maker.description: Vakavuna na yasa dria ena dua na vuaka lalai, ka raica na vakatakarakara e dau tu vakatautauvata e sisi, ena kala e va e dua na yacana kei na dua na veiqaqa. E sega ni liga se maraqa. E sega ni dokai ena caka kei na peni.
pattern-maker.short: Vakavuna na yasa dria ena vuaka lalai, ka raica ni vakatakarakara e dau tu.
pattern-maker.players: 1 se 2 na tamata, vata ena yasa dua
pattern-maker.intro: Vuaka lalai e 3 by 3 yasa dria, se 4 by 4 ke vinakata, kei na "na vakatakarakara yau" e sisi: na vuaka oya e dau tu vakalevu ena dua na yavu. Tapa dua na yasa dria, e sokova ki na kala e muri ena va e va kei na yacana kei na veiqaqa. Na vakatakarakara e sisi e vakavou vakadua. E sega na vakatakarakara dodonu, ka sega talega ni vakaraitaki se vakauta. "Vakaraitaka na vakatakarakara yau" e vakayagataka me vakatakarakara ena pepa me vakatokai, me caka vata kina se me soli vei ira.
howTo: Raica na vuaka kei na vakatakarakara yau e sisi. Eratou e dua na vuaka, e dau tu vakalevu.
Tapa dua na yasa dria. E sokova ki na kala e muri ena ibalebale ni kala e va ena lewe.
Tapa na yasa dria ena yaco vakavinaka na vakatakarakara vinakata. Dua na vakatakarakara e sa dodonu.
Tapa "Vakavuna sa vaka vou" me vuaka vou, se "Dau sa" me vakavou. "Vakasuka" me vakasuka na vuaka sa yaco.
Tapa "Vakaraitaka na vakatakarakara yau" kevaka vinakata me vakatakarakara ena pepa, se tapa Rest me sa vakamuri.
tips: Tu vata vakasolesolea ka veiwaqaliti: dua e tapa dua na yapa, ka na ikuri e vakamacalataka na nona raica.
Vosa vata ena ka mo raica: “Oqo e vakatautauvata me dua na vuaka.” Sega na dodonu me mo vakamacalataka dua na ka.
Vakadidi na tile oqo ena kala e rua duadua, ka vakaoqo ena kala e va.
Ena pepa, na pattern e rawa ni vakalatai ena pensili, vakavakaduri ena vakaivalavala ni kaado, se vakasaqara ena dua na gifi lalai.

faq.q: E tiko na taimi se na maki?
faq.a: Sega. Sega na uasivi, na maki, na kaunisiko se na veiciqoma. Ko rawa ni tu vakaoti ena dua na taimi, ka na vakaoti vinaka ena veivakaoti ena dua na ka vinaka.

faq.q: E savetaki se tukuna na ka au vakaduidui?
faq.a: Sega. Na tile dina ena peji oqo duadua. Sega ni savetaki, tukuna se kaunisi, ka sa lako yani ena nomu tako mai ena peji. Ke via vakasaqara dua na pattern, vakaprinti.

faq.q: Se ko vakasala na yapa sala se ko vakasala na tile ena vakasala?
faq.a: Sega na yapa sala: vakatogotogo ena yapa me vakavuna na kala e muri. Ena “Tekivu sara” se “Ka vakavuvuli”, “Vakasubuti” e vakasubutuka na tile au tu ena imuri.

faq.q: E rawa ni vakaitavi ena kala ena tamata e vakalialia ena kala?
faq.a: Era vakatovolea me vaka oqo. Dua na vosa e tiko ena kala kece, ka dua na shape lalai e tiko ena yapa kece, ka sega ni dua na kala e dodonu me vakaraitaka ena kala. Era vakatautauvata ena veivakatovolea ena vakalialia ni kala ena ulu-damudamu kei na kuru-uli. Ia sa sega ni dua e vakalialia ena kala oqo ka vakatovolea, ka ke mo raica ni dua na kala e tautauvata, mo vakaroti keimami.

faq.q: Sa vakatotoka vinaka na yapa ena veiyalayala se ena screen lalai?
faq.a: Dua na yapa kece e tiko ena 56 pixels ena vuaka. Ke na tile e tiko ena vanua ni screen, e tadu ena loma ni nona bokoc, sega ni vakasiko ena yapa.

faq.q: E tiko na version ena pepa?
faq.a: Io. “Print my pattern” e prinitaka na pattern au cavuta ena dua na peji, ena kala e va kei na yacadra. E rawa vinaka ena cakacaka vuravura kei na vakabalavu, ka ena kala kece e tiko kina na shape.

faq.q: E na dau vakavuna, se e dodonu me vakaresi?
faq.a: Io, e vakavuna, ka sega na akaunti, na vakarau se na vakarau ena soqo. E rawa ni cakacaka ena web browser ena foni, ena tablet se ena komputa.

drawing-duet.name: Drawing ena rua
drawing-duet.seoTitle: Drawing ena Rua: Rua na Tamata, Dua na Pepa
drawing-duet.h1: Drawing ena Rua: Rua na Tamata ka Dua na Pepa
drawing-duet.description: Rua na tamata era vakaduidui ena veiwaqai ena dua na canvas vata, ka dua na kala ena nodra. Sega ni dua e kalou se dau kauta, ka na rawa ni saveti se prinitaka na drawing. E vakavuna ena veiwaqai, sega na akaunti.
drawing-duet.short: Vakaduidui ena dua na drawing vata me vakavuna dua na tamata e tu vata kemuni.
drawing-duet.intro: Dua na canvas, rua na tamata. Ko dua ka mai vakarau dua na kala, ka kala e dua na yaca vakaivola. Era vuoro: vakadua dua na yaca se shape, qai tuku na pen. Dua ka dua era rawa ni tuku ena veivanua kece. Sega ni dua na drawing dodonu, sega ni dua na maki. Saveti na drawing ena nomu cakacaka ke o via, se prinitaka na version ena pepa: dua na pepa, rua na pen.
howTo: Dua ka dua era vakarau dua na kala. Na banner e vakaraitaka na vuoro, kei na kala na tamata oqo ena yaca.
Vakadua dua na yaca se shape ena yavu, ena mouse se pen. Se ko rawa ni veiwaqai na arrow keys kei na Space me drawing ena sega ni pointer.
Ke sa mai vaka, tapa “Tuku na pen”. Dua ka dua era rawa ni tuku ena veivanua kece.
Tapa “Vakasubuti na nomu yaca muri” me vakasaqara na yaca muri duadua ena tamata e vuoro.
Tapa “Saveti na drawing” me vakatu dua na faili ena cakacaka oqo, se “Prinitaka na pepa” ena dua na pepa, rua na pen.
tips: Tu vata vakasolesolea ka vosa ena veidrawing: “Au na vakatautauvata dua na siga ena dua na kedra.”
Tekivu ena dua na tiki, dua na yaca se dua na shape, ka vakadidi ena veiqaravi ena tamata e vuoro.
Sega ni dua e dodonu me drawing dua na ka. Dua na pattern ena yaca e vinaka me baleta dua na veivanua.
Ke o via tu, tapa “Oti ena ua”. Na nomu drawing e sega ni tiko ke o sa lako mai ena peji ke sega ni saveti.

faq.q: E tiko na dua e wini se na maki?
faq.a: Sega. Sega na wini, na maki, na taimi se na yawa ni vuoro. Sega ni dua na drawing dodonu, ka sega ni vakaraitaka se vakatautauvataka na ka.

faq.q: E saveti se tukuna na drawing?
faq.a: Sega, sega ni dua na ka e tukuna. Na drawing e tiko ena peji oqo ka sa vaka tiko kina ke o sa lako mai. Ke o tapa “Saveti na drawing”, dua na faili e vakatu ena nomu cakacaka me vakatu mai. Sega ni dua e vakauta.

faq.q: E rawa ni vakasubuti dua na yaca?
faq.a: Io. “Vakasubuti na nomu yaca muri” e vakasaqara na yaca muri ena tamata e vuoro. “Tekivu sara” e vakavoleka na pepa, ka “Vakasubuti” e vakavuna na yaca, dua na vuaka mai muri.

faq.q: E rawa ni veiwaqai ena sega ni mouse se ena screen ni tauri?
faq.a: Io. Ke na drawing e tiko ena yavu, na arrow keys e veisoti na dot ni pen, ka na Space e tuku ena pen e tiko se e laki. Na screen e vosa “Pen e tiko” se “Pen e laki” ena veivuke kece.

faq.q: Na cava na kala, ka sa rawa ni vakalialia ena vakayogeyoge ena kala?
faq.a: Kuru, moli, damudamu kei na vulavula, na kala kece era veiwaqai ena noda veivakatovolea vakaloloma. Dua ka dua e tiko kina na vosa vakavuravura, ka era vakaraitaki ena vuoro. Era vakatovolea ena veivakatautauvata ni vakalialia ena raica, ia sa sega ni dua na tamata e vakalialia ena kala oqo ka vakatovolea.

faq.q: E tiko na version ena pepa?
faq.a: Io. “Prinitaka na pepa” e prinitaka dua na pepa e tiko kina na tikina, ka dua na frame lalai vakavoleka me vakadrawing kina, ena rua na tamata kei na rua na pen. E rawa ena kala ena kala se ena kala-kala.

faq.q: E na dau vakavuna, se e dodonu me vakaresi?
faq.a: Ioio, sega ni vakatau vuli, ka sega ni dua na akaunti, vakarau ni vakauluti se soqo. E vakayagataka ena ivakatakilakila ni initaneti ena yaca ni vakatutu, ipad se komipiuta.

build-together.name: Buildi vata
build-together.seoTitle: Build Together: Two People Build One Pattern
build-together.h1: Build Together: Two People, One Grid
build-together.description: Two people take turns to put a piece in a shared grid until it is full, each with a color of their own that has a name and a shape. Nobody wins, and there is no timer or score. Free to play and print.
build-together.short: Take turns with someone beside you to fill one shared grid.
build-together.intro: A shared grid of 4 by 4 places, or 3 by 3 if you like. Each of you picks a color, and each color has its own written name and shape. You take turns: on your turn, tap an empty place to put your piece there. When every place has a piece, the picture is built together. There is no winner, because you make it as a pair, and nothing is saved or sent. "Print the grid" puts an empty grid on one page so you can build with two pencils.
howTo: Each of you picks a color. A color the other person has is marked "In use".
The first person goes first. The screen says whose turn it is and which color is theirs.
Tap an empty place to put your piece there. The turn passes to the other person.
If you would rather not place a piece, tap "Pass". Either of you may pass at any time.
When every place has a piece, you have built the picture together. Tap "Start again" to build another, or tap Rest to stop.
tips: Sit side by side so you can both see and reach the screen. Talk as you go: "I will put mine next to yours."
Try to build a pattern, stripes, a checkerboard or a border, or just place pieces anywhere you like. Both are fine.
A child or a person who tires easily can pass as often as they like. The picture is still built together.
On paper, each person uses one pencil and draws their own shape in the empty squares.

faq.q: Is there a winner, a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no winner, because you build one picture together. There is no clock, score, count of pieces or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: Is anything we make saved or sent?
faq.a: No. The grid stays on this page only. It is not saved, uploaded or counted, and it is gone when you close the page. If you would like to keep it, print the grid and build on paper.

faq.q: What if I put a piece in the wrong place?
faq.a: There is no wrong place. Tap "Take back the last piece" and the turn goes back to you. You can take back one step at a time, and a pass can be taken back too.

faq.q: Can the four colors be told apart by people with color-blindness?
faq.a: They were chosen to be. Every color also has a written name and its own small shape in each piece, so color is never the only way to tell them apart. The four colors were checked with simulations of red-green and blue-yellow color blindness. A person with color blindness has not yet tried them, so please tell us if two look alike.

faq.q: Are the places big enough for a tremor or a small screen?
faq.a: Every place is at least 56 pixels across. If the grid is too wide for the screen, it scrolls sideways inside its own box rather than shrinking the places.

faq.q: Is there a paper version?
faq.a: Yes. "Print the grid" prints an empty grid on one page with the two colors and their names, to build with two pencils. It works in black and white because every color has its own shape.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

seated-toss.name: Seated toss tally
seated-toss.seoTitle: Seated Toss Tally: a Bean-Bag Game for Two
seated-toss.h1: Seated Toss Tally: Toss Together at a Table
seated-toss.description: Two people at a table take turns tossing a soft bean bag into a big target and keep the tally on paper. Nothing is timed or scored. Free to print.
seated-toss.short: Take turns tossing a bean bag at a big target, with the tally on paper.
seated-toss.intro: A calm tossing game for two people sitting at a table. You lay a printed target on the table and take turns tossing a soft bean bag, or a rolled-up sock, so that it lands on the rings. Each of you keeps a tally by ticking boxes on paper, and you look at the ticks together when you stop. Nothing is timed, nothing is added up on screen, and nothing is saved or sent. Please read the safety notes first: small fillings are a choking hazard.
howTo: Read the safety notes. Choose a bag with a sewn-shut cover, or roll up a clean sock.
Tap "Print the target and tally sheet" and lay the sheet flat on the table between you.
Sit comfortably, one on each side, and take turns with one gentle toss each. Anyone may pass.
When a toss lands in a ring, tick a box in your column, on the row for that ring.
Look at the ticks together when you stop, or tap Rest to pause.
tips: Sit close enough that a gentle underhand toss reaches the target without any stretching.
Talk about the toss, not the result: "That was a soft one." Everyone cheers for every toss.
A rolled-up sock is light and easy to hold with a weak grip. Rest an arm on the table between turns.
If someone would rather watch, they can be the one who ticks the boxes.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: Is it safe to toss a bean bag?
faq.a: It can be, with care. Use a bag with a sewn-shut cover or a rolled-up sock, never loose beans, rice or small fillings, which are a choking hazard for young children and for anyone who puts things in their mouth. Stay seated, toss gently toward the table and never toward a face, and keep an adult close by.

faq.q: Is anything counted or saved on the screen?
faq.a: No. The tally is only on paper, in boxes you tick yourselves. The page keeps no count and no timer, and nothing is saved or sent.

faq.q: What if someone cannot toss, or the bag lands off the sheet?
faq.a: Anyone may pass, and a bag that lands off the sheet is simply picked up for the next turn. Nothing is counted for it.

faq.q: What is on the printed sheet?
faq.a: One page: a large target with its three rings named Near, Middle and Far, a table with a column for each person and a row of small boxes to tick for each ring, and a line of safety advice. The names are written on the rings, so it works in black and white.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

seasonal-pack.name: Seasonal puzzle pack
seasonal-pack.seoTitle: Seasonal Puzzle Pack: Printable Paper Puzzles
seasonal-pack.h1: Seasonal Puzzle Pack: Three Paper Puzzles for Each Season
seasonal-pack.description: Three small printable puzzles for spring, summer, autumn or winter: match the pairs, circle the one that is different, and color a picture in. Choose a season, or take a rest day. Free to print.
seasonal-pack.short: Three printable puzzles for the season you choose, or a rest day.
seasonal-pack.players: All ages, solo or side by side
seasonal-pack.intro: Choose a season, and the page shows three small paper puzzles drawn from that season's pictures: two rows to join with lines, a row of four to circle the one that is different, and a picture to color in. You print one page, then do one, two or all three, at your own pace. Choose "Today is a rest day" instead and there is nothing to do.
howTo: Choose a season, or choose "Today is a rest day".
Look at the three puzzles, then tap "Print this season's pack".
Do one, two or all three, at your own pace.
Join the matching pictures with a line, circle the one that is different, and color the large picture in.
Stop whenever you like. A rest day is a good day too.
tips: Start with the puzzle that feels easiest today. One is enough.
Say the name of each picture aloud, if that helps.
Use crayons or pencils. Any colors are fine.
Keep the page for next time, or let it go.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: Does the page know which season it is?
faq.a: No. You choose the season. The page does not look at the date or your location.

faq.q: Is there a score or a right answer?
faq.a: No. Nothing is timed, scored or checked on the screen, and no answers are shown. Each puzzle is only a picture to look at, join, circle or color.

faq.q: What if nobody wants puzzles today?
faq.a: Choose "Today is a rest day". The page then shows one calm line, and there is nothing to print or do.

faq.q: What is on the printed sheet?
faq.a: One page for the season you chose: its three puzzles, each with a short line of how to do it, and a line saying you can do one, two or all three.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

decorate-a-card.name: Decorate a card together
decorate-a-card.seoTitle: Decorate a Card Together: a Printable Greeting Card
decorate-a-card.h1: Decorate a Card Together: Make One for Someone
decorate-a-card.description: Two people decorate a printed greeting card for a birthday, a thank you or just because, then write a message on the back together. Crayons or pens only. No timer or score. Free to print.
decorate-a-card.short: Decorate a printed greeting card together.
decorate-a-card.intro: A quiet making game for two people sitting side by side. You print one sheet, which folds in half to make a card. Choose an occasion, such as a birthday or a thank you, and decorate the front around its words. Then write a message on the back, together or one person writing what the other says. Use crayons, colored pencils or felt-tip pens. There is no right card, and nothing is timed, scored or sent.
howTo: Vali se okasio, ketekete ana "Print the card" (Bobo na kaic).
Tauna na pepa ena tiki ni vuvu, me vakacaucautaka na vanua e liu ena kena vuravura.
Dua e vakaraitaka na liu, ka dua tale e vakaraitaka na muri, se mo vakaraitaka ena dua na vanua ena veivuoro.
Mo vakatakilakila e dua na itukutuku vakavesuki. Dua e dodonu me vakatakilakila, ka dua tale e vakanuinui ena nona vosa.
Mo tu ena gauna era kila kina na loloma. Dua na kaci vakadodonu e rawa ni vakarogoca vinaka, ena loloma tale eso.
tips: Mo vakatekivu ena vosa e liu ena kaci, ka muri oqo mo vakasinai na vonu, na uto se na dodo ena vakavolivoli, dua ka dua.
Ke sa beci mai dua me sega ni vakaraitaka, era rawa ni digitaka na kena loli se me vakatakilakila na itukutuku.
Mo vosa na dodonu e vakaraitaki ena nona vakaraitaki na tamata tale eso, ia sega ni vosa ena sa vinaka se sa sega.
Tausa na kaci ena vanua me rawa ni solia, se me tu kina ena teveli ena gauna oqo.

faq.q: Sa vakadeitaki na gauna se na maki?
faq.a: Sega. Sega ni wati, na maki, na vakaraitaki vuli se na sa lutu. Mo rawa ni tu ena gauna kina, ia na tu ena lomaloma e dua na gauna vinaka me oti kina.

faq.q: E dodonu me vaka na kulu, na sisa se na sitika?
faq.a: Sega. Na pensara, na pensara lolo se na peni ena digi e rawa. Sega ni dodonu me vaka, me vakasirai se me vakaduri.

faq.q: E rawa ni da vakayagataka e dua na gauna sega ni vakaraitaki ena lisi?
faq.a: Vakayagataka "Just because" ka vosa ena nomu itukutuku ena liu, se me vakaraitaka na kaci ena sega ni gauna.

faq.q: Is anything counted, judged or saved on the screen?
faq.a: Sega. Na peji e vakaraitaka ga na kaci kei na tikitiki. Sega ni vakaraitaki na vuli, na maka se na tanitaki, ia sega na kaci dodonu.

faq.q: E cava ena pepa e vakaraitaki?
faq.a: Dua na peji: dua na kaci e tauna ena vuvu, e vakaraitaki kina na vosa ena gauna kei dua na vakaraitaki vakavuvu ena liu, kei na vanua me vakatakilakila na itukutuku kei na Mai ena muri. Na tikitiki ni veiwekani e vakaraitaki ena yaca.

faq.q: E ca beka, e dodonu me vakarautaka na kaunti?
faq.a: Io, e ca beka, ia sega ni kaunti, vakarautaki se tuku. E rawa ena vakatakilakila ena veibeci, ena tabulet se ena komputa.

find-together.name: Find together
find-together.seoTitle: Find Together: Two People Find the Pairs
find-together.h1: Find Together: Two People, One Team
find-together.description: Two people share one screen and take turns turning over two picture cards to look for a pair. Pairs are found together and counted on one shared tally. Free to play, with no timer or score.
find-together.short: Take turns with someone beside you to find the picture pairs.
find-together.intro: The cards start with their pictures showing, or you can lay them face down. On your turn you turn over two cards. If they are a pair, you have found it together and the turn passes. If they are different, they stay face up until you press "Turn them back", so you can both look. Pass at any time. The tally at the top only goes up: the pairs you have found together.
howTo: Vakarau na veivuke e sa na kaunta kina na kaci. E vinaka me vakatekivu ena kaci e ono, e tolu na veiwekani.
Na skrini e vakaraitaka na vuro e sa ni vakatu, kei na yavu me dua na tamata kei na vakacakacaka me dua na tamata ika rua.
Vakavolivoli kaci e rua, dua ka muri ena dua. Ke vaka e tautauvata, e ka oti na veiwekani ena veivuke.
Ke sa duidui, ketekete "Turn them back" ke sa rawa mo rua ni sa vakarautaka. Ena gauna oqo e sa sa lako ena vuro tani.
Dua ena kena vuro e rawa ni ketekete "Pass" ena gauna kece. Ketekete "Start again" me kaci vou, se ketekete Rest me tu.
tips: Tu va-vono ena yava kei dua ka mo vosa ena vosa ena kena lewe: "A teacup. Do you take milk in your tea?"
Mo solia na tamata e kuvea iko ni cabe, koya e ka dodonu me ketekete, ka e rawa ni tautauvata. Mo vakaraitaka ena yaca, sega ni ketekete ena vuna.
Digitaka "Cards face down" ke mo rua era marau ni veivolitaki kaci me kila na vuro.
Dua e sa sauma ena gauna e rawa ni mocu ena gauna kece. E sa veiwekani ga na veivuke.

faq.q: E dua e wini, na gauna se na maki?
faq.a: Sega. Sega ni wini, ni ko veiwekani ena veivuke. Sega ni wati, na maki, se na kunei ena veikaukauwa. Na tikitiki e kaunti ga na veivuke ko veiwekani ena veivuke, ia e rawa ni mo mocu ena gauna kece.

faq.q: E dodonu me vakila na vuro e tu kina na vuro?
faq.a: Sega. Na veivakatokai e tu ena vuro kece e vakaraitaki. Ke na kaci e vakaraitaki ena yaca, era rawa ni vosa na nomu kila, se mo vakaraitaki tale.

faq.q: E cava ke rua na kaci e duidui?
faq.a: E ra na tu ena yaca me mo rawa ni kila, ena gauna mo sa vinaka kina. Sega dua e vakaraitaki ena yaca. Ke sa vakarautaka, ketekete "Turn them back" ka e liu na veivuke ki na tamata tale eso.

faq.q: E vakaraitaki se e tukuna ena veivuke ko keitou vakayagataka?
faq.a: Sega. Na kaci e tu ga ena peji oqo. Sega dua e vakaraitaki, e tukuna se e kaunti, ia e sa yaco ke mo tiko na peji.

faq.q: E lewe ena kaci me rawa ni vakaraitaka na vuli se na skrini lalahi?
faq.a: Kaci kece e 64 pixels ena vuravura, ia e lewe tiko ena kena rawa ena skrini. Ena kila kina na kaci ena yaca kei na vakaraitaki.

faq.q: E ca beka, e dodonu me vakarautaka na kaunti?
faq.a: Io, e ca beka, ia sega ni kaunti, vakarautaki se tuku. E rawa ena veibeci, ena tabulet se ena komputa.

story-dice.name: Story dice
story-dice.seoTitle: Story Dice: a Picture Storytelling Game
story-dice.h1: Story Dice: Tell a Story with Pictures
story-dice.description: Three or four picture dice to tell a story with, in any order. No reading, no right answer, no timer and no score. Roll again, or pass. Free to play and print.
story-dice.short: Roll picture dice and tell a story together, in any order.
story-dice.players: 2 or more people, or an adult and a child
story-dice.intro: Hoki e toko tolu se va, ka rawa ni tolu, e dau cavuti vakaoti na ivakatakilakila ena veiyaya. Ni vakavuna, mo vakatakilakila ka vakatokai vakamuri ena veisau. Na tukutuku e rawa ni dua se rua na vosa, ka e rawa ni vakaloloma se vakaivakadinadina ena yalo. E sega ni dua na tukutuku dina, ka sega ni dui kerea nomu sa vakaisi, se vakamamarotaki ena yalo. Tapa "Vakarau ka" me ra cavuti vou, ka dua e rawa ni vakalutu.
howTo: Digitaka tolu se va na toko. Tolu e vakalailai ena vakatolutolu.
Raica vata na ivakatakilakila. Tapa dua ni o gadreva me mo cakava vakaoqo.
Vakatakilakila mo vakavuvuli tukutuku ena ivakatakilakila, ena veisau. Dua na vosa ena dua na yalo e rawa vakalevu.
Dua e rawa ni vakalutu. Tapa "Lutu", ka tamata e sokovi e rawa ni tekivu.
Tapa "Vakarau ka" me ra cavuti vou ina ivakatakilakila, ni o gadreva, se tapa Vakaraitaki me mo tiko.
tips: Vakayagataka e dua na taro sai koya ga ni mo qai raica na isau: "Na cava e rawa ni lako kina na vuli ni ka?"
Vakavuvuli ena veisau e cavuti na tamata ni sa muria, sega ni vakadeitaka. E rawa ni vakayagataka tukutuku.
Tukutuku e rawa ni vakavuvuli ena dua na nona yalomatua. Dua na ivakatakilakila e vakavuvuli vinaka ena veika oqo.

faq.q: E tiko e dua na uasivi se vuaka?
faq.a: Sega. E sega ni dua na uasivi, vuaka, cavuti ni veisau, se vakamaroroi. O rawa ni tiko ena gauna kece, ka tiko ena vuqa e dau vakavuvuli vinaka na veika.

faq.q: E gadreva me'u wiliwili se vakaraitaka ivakatakilakila?
faq.a: Sega. E rawa ni cavuti na veiyaya ena ivakatakilakila gona. E rawa ni vakaraitaka, vakamacalataka, se kaya ga na veika e vakamaharaki kina. Sega ni kerei me vakamacalataka se vakamaharaki dina.

faq.q: Na cava ke dua e sega ni gadreva me cavuti?
faq.a: E rawa ni lutu ena gauna kece ena sega ni dua na kena vakamacala. Na veiyaya e tu vakaraitaki, ka tamata sokovi e rawa ni tekivu, se mo rawa ni vakarau ka cavuti vou.

faq.q: E tiko e dua na veisau ena pepa?
faq.a: Io. Dua na pepa e dua na tabana e tiko kina na ivakatakilakila e drokadroka ka vica va dua e vaka ni yaka ena rarama e va. Digitaka dua na rarama, se vakavuravura ka digitaka dua mai na vakasoqoni.

faq.q: E vakarogoci ga, ka e gadreva me'u vakauru ena vakaukauwa?
faq.a: Io, e vakarogoci, ka sega ni dua na akaunti, vakauru se vakaraitaki. E rawa ni cakava ena ibrauza ena vakaukauwa, ena yabaki ni tabledi, se ena kompiuta.

word-and-picture-pairs.name: Vosa kei na ivakatakilakila e vakaveirogoi
word-and-picture-pairs.seoTitle: Word and Picture Pairs: Match Words to Pictures
word-and-picture-pairs.h1: Vosa kei na Ivakatakilakila: Vakaveirogoi na Vosa ki na Ivakatakilakila
word-and-picture-pairs.description: Vakaveirogoi na vosa vakaveiveiti ki na ivakatakilakila, ka rogoca dina dua na vosa ena vosa vakailavo. Na ivakatakilakila e tiko ena vuqa, sega ni dua na uasivi, vuaka se vakacaucau na vakatotoro. Veiqaqa ena kena cavuti kei na kena vakatanitani.
word-and-picture-pairs.short: Vakaveirogoi dua na vosa ki na ivakatakilakila, ka rogoca ena vosa vakailavo.
word-and-picture-pairs.players: Dua na tamata makawa, se dau dua na vuvale e cavuti ena veivuke
word-and-picture-pairs.intro: E cavuti vakaraitaki e va se ono na ivakatakilakila, ka ra tu ena vakasaqara e sega ni dua, ka vosa vakaveiveiti ena vosa Vakavalagi. Tapa dua na vosa qai tapa na ivakatakilakila, se tapa dua na ivakatakilakila qai tapa na vosa. Dua na veipamagi e vakaveirogoi e tiko ena kena dua na vakatutu lolovira ka vosa ni "Vakaveirogoi". Tapa "Vakarogoca" e tu vata ni dua na vosa me'u rogoca kina ena vosa vakailavo. Sega ni dua na gauna e vakaraitaki, se vakavuna na veivakavuvuli, ka dua na tapa e sega ni vakaveirogoi e vakacaucautaki ena yaloyalo.
howTo: Digitaka e va se ono na ivakatakilakila. E va e vakalailai ena vakatolutolu.
Tapa dua na vosa, qai tapa na ivakatakilakila e vakamacalataka. Se tapa dua na ivakatakilakila mai liu, qai tapa na vosana.
Dua na veipamagi e vakaveirogoi e tiko vata. Dua na tapa e sega ni vakaveirogoi e vakacaucau vakavinaka, ka vakarau vakavinaka ena dua tale.
Tapa "Vakarogoca" e tu vata ni dua na vosa me'u rogoca kina, ke na rawa ni wilika ni vosa ena ivakanananu.
Tapa "Ivakatakilakila vou" me'u digitaka dua na vakasoqoni tale, se "Vakarau ka" me ra vakavakacaucautaki na veipaqi kece. "Vakasubu" e vakacuruma na veiveirogoi mai liu.
tips: Vosa vata na vosa kece ena dua na gauna sa vakaveirogoi kina, ka vosa vata nona ivakatakilakila.
Vuvale e rawa ni vakavuevuetaki na gauna. Tamata kece e digitaka dua na vosa se ivakatakilakila ena gauna dua.
Vakayagataka muria na vosa e kila me yaco, ka tiko vakavuravura na kena vosa tale.

faq.q: E tiko e dua na uasivi se vuaka?
faq.a: Sega. E sega ni dua na uasivi, vuaka, cavuti ni veisau, se vakamaroroi. O rawa ni tiko ena gauna kece, ka tiko ena vuqa e dau vakavuvuli vinaka na veika.

faq.q: E vakayacori ena wiliwili?
faq.a: E vakayacori ena tamata makawa e vakavulici ena vosa Vakavalagi se vakaraitaki ena vosa, kei na vuvale e cavuti vata ena veivuke. E sega ni vakayacori ena wiliwili.

faq.q: Na cava ke sega ni rawa ni wilika na vosa vakailavo ena nodra masini?
faq.a: Na bulumu Rogoca e vakayagataka na leqa e tiko ena ibrauza. Ke sega ni rawa ni vosa ibrauza, na bulumu e sega ni vakaraitaki, ka cavuti ena veiyaya e sega ni kenai.

faq.q: E tiko e dua na veisau ena pepa?
faq.a: Io. Dua na pepa e tiko kina e ono na ivakatakilakila kei na ka vosa e ono, me'u drokadroka se me'u vakavoui ena dua na yaca.

faq.q: E vakarogoci, ka e gadreva me'u vakauru ena vakaukauwa?
faq.a: Io, e vakarogoci, ka sega ni dua na akaunti, vakauru se vakaraitaki. E rawa ni cakava ena ibrauza ena vakaukauwa, ena yabaki ni tabledi, se ena kompiuta.

sort-together.h1: Vakarautaka Vata: e dua na itaviqaravi ni Vakarautaka na Iyaloyalo
sort-together.description: Tapa dua na ivakatakilakila, qai tapa na kato e vakaveitikitiki kina: kuku se veikoro, sucu se manumanu. Dua na veiyaya vakaveiveiti e marautaki, vakarogoci, ka sega ni dua na totoro, vakavuvale kei na tamata makawa.
sort-together.short: Biuta na iyaloyalo yadua ena kena basikete: valenisili se iteitei, kei na so tale.

Tabaka e dua na iyaloyalo. E rawata e dua na iyalayala koula.

Ni sa vakarautaki na iyaloyalo kece, raica vata na basikete.
tips: E dau sega na isaunitaro cala ena bula dina. Kevaka e dua e kaya ni dua na tavaya ni wai e nona na valenisili, taroga na vuna. O na rawata beka e dua na italanoa vinaka.

picture-puzzle.description: Dua na vakavuvuli ivakatakilakila vakaukauwa ena tamata makawa: 4 se 9 na vosavosa levu, na ivakatakilakila kece e tiko vakavuravura, ka tapa rua na vosavosa me vakasoqoni. picture-puzzle.short: Tabaka e rua na tiki me veisautaki ira me yacova ni sa taucoko na iyaloyalo.
picture-puzzle.intro: Dua na ivakatakilakila vinaka e vakatevutaki ka vakasavasavataki ena vosavosa e va se iva. Na ivakatakilakila kece e tiko vakavuravura me dua na ituvatuva. Veivosakitaka na iyaloyalo ni sa lako vata mai: "E tiko na katubaleka damudamu."
E dua na jigsaw kau dina kei na 12 ki na 24 na tiki lelevu e dua na itaviqaravi ni teveli taleitaki talega.

finish-the-saying.seoTitle: Vakamuria na Vosa: Veiyaya ni Vosa Vakaukauwa
finish-the-saying.description: Na vosa kilai levu ni Amerika kei na iotioti ni vosa e yali, me vaka na "E dua na peni vakabulai e dua na peni ___".
finish-the-saying.short: Vakacavara vata na vosa kilai levu, qai veitalanoataka.
finish-the-saying.intro: Na vosa makawa e dau kilai levu ena dua na bula taucoko. Na kadi yadua e vakaraitaka e dua na vosa kilai levu kei na iotioti ni vosa e yali, tolu na digidigi, kei na dua na "Vakaraitaka na itinitini" button. Ni oti na itinitini, e dua na taro malumu e sureta na veivosaki.

word-search.name: Vakasaqara na vosa tabaki levu
word-search.seoTitle: Ivakatakilakila ena Vosa Vakalevu, Vakaukauwa ka Rawa ni Vakaitavi
word-search.description: Dua na veiyaya ena vosa e vakalevu ena vosa vakalevu, vakaukauwa, ena tamata makawa kei na vuvale. Vosa lailai, ka dua na salatu levu, era tu ki na sala kei na sala. Cavuti ena ibrauza se vakaitavi.
word-search.short: Na matanivola lelevu, vica na vosa, ena yasa kei na sobu ga. Tabaka talega.
word-search.intro: E dua na grid lailai kei na matanivola lelevu kei na vica walega na vosa, wiliki kece ena yasana se sobu. Tabaka na imatai ni matanivola ni dua na vosa, qai kena iotioti ni matanivola. Vinakata na pepa? Tabaka e dua na puzzle vou ena dua ga na tavaya.

faq.q: E rawa beka niu tabaka na vosa vakasaqaqara?
